object.label: AAR Record
object.description: Top-level Annual Activity Review record owned by a Principal Investigator. One per PI per review cycle.
object.permission_notes: PIs can only access their own AAR records. Evaluators get read/edit on assigned records. Institute leadership gets read visibility across their institute.

fields.label: PI
fields.notes: Links AAR to the Principal Investigator's Contact record. Drives ownership and sharing.

fields.label: Review Year
fields.notes: Fiscal or calendar year for the review cycle.

fields.label: Status
fields.notes: Drives workflow stages and evaluator visibility.

fields.label: Institute
fields.notes: Research institute the PI belongs to. Used for institute leadership rollup visibility.

fields.label: Submission Date
fields.notes: Stamped automatically when Status transitions to Submitted.

fields.label: Pre-Populated From Grants
fields.notes: Indicates whether the record was seeded from the Grants system integration.

object.label: AAR Submission
object.description: Child object capturing the PI's formal submission content within an AAR Record.

fields.label: AAR Record
fields.notes: Master-detail to AAR_Record__c. Deletion of parent cascades to submissions.

fields.label: PI Narrative
fields.notes: Free-text PI self-assessment narrative submitted as part of the AAR.

object.label: AAR Reviewer
object.description: Junction/child object linking an Evaluator (User or Contact) to a specific AAR Record. Drives evaluator access via sharing rules.

fields.label: AAR Record
fields.notes: Master-detail to AAR_Record__c. Evaluator assignment is scoped to one AAR.

fields.label: Evaluator
fields.notes: The internal Salesforce User designated as evaluator for this AAR.

object.label: Commercialization
object.description: Stores patents, licenses, IP disclosures, and other commercialization activities sourced from the Wellspring system via CSV upsert.

implementation_phase.now: Create object shell with core structural fields only (Wellspring_ID__c, Contact__c, AAR_Record__c, Title__c)
implementation_phase.deferred: Full field list deferred until Wellspring CSV schema confirmed by Research Strategy

core_structural_implement_now.label: Wellspring ID
core_structural_implement_now.notes: Primary key from Wellspring. Used as upsert key during CSV integration.

core_structural_implement_now.label: PI / Inventor
core_structural_implement_now.notes: Links the commercialization activity to the PI/Inventor Contact record.

core_structural_implement_now.label: AAR Record
core_structural_implement_now.notes: Optional link to the parent AAR Record. Nullable until CSV data confirms match.

deferred_pending_csv_schema.label: Last Sync Date
deferred_pending_csv_schema.notes: Timestamp of last successful Wellspring CSV sync for this record.

object.label: Contact
object.description: Standard Contact object extended to serve as the PI/Inventor anchor. All custom AAR and Commercialization objects relate back to Contact for ownership and sharing.

fields.label: Grants System ID
fields.notes: Used for 100% match validation during Grants system integration. Required for pre-population accuracy tracking (>95% target per Phase 1 gate).

fields.label: Institute
fields.notes: Mirrors the Institute field on AAR_Record__c. Drives institute leadership sharing rules.

fields.label: Is Active PI
fields.notes: Flag synced from Grants system. Only active PIs are eligible for AAR creation.

relationships.name: AAR_Record__c → Contact
relationships.notes: Each AAR belongs to one PI (Contact). A PI may have multiple AARs across years.

relationships.name: AAR_Submission__c → AAR_Record__c
relationships.notes: Submission is tightly owned by the AAR. Sharing and visibility are controlled by the parent.

relationships.name: AAR_Reviewer__c → AAR_Record__c
relationships.notes: Reviewer records drive evaluator access. Deleting the AAR removes all reviewer assignments.

relationships.name: AAR_Reviewer__c → User
relationships.notes: Evaluator must be a licensed internal Salesforce User. Used to derive sharing rule grant.

relationships.name: Commercialization__c → Contact
relationships.notes: Ties each commercialization activity to the PI/Inventor. Required for Experience Cloud FLS.

relationships.name: Commercialization__c → AAR_Record__c
relationships.notes: Optional. Populated when a Commercialization record is associated with a specific review year. May be null at import time and resolved later.

permission_sets.name: AAR_PI_Access
permission_sets.description: Grants PIs read/edit access to their own AAR records only.

permission_sets.name: AAR_Evaluator_Access
permission_sets.description: Grants evaluators read/edit on AARs they are assigned to via AAR_Reviewer__c records.

permission_sets.name: AAR_Institute_Leadership
permission_sets.description: Grants institute leaders read-only visibility to all AARs within their institute.

sharing_rules.name: Evaluator_AAR_Share
sharing_rules.description: When an AAR_Reviewer__c record is created, share the parent AAR_Record__c with the Evaluator__c User at Read/Write.
sharing_rules.implementation_note: Recommend Apex Managed Sharing via trigger on AAR_Reviewer__c for dynamic, row-level control.

sharing_rules.name: Institute_Leadership_Share
sharing_rules.description: Share all AAR_Record__c records where Institute__c = [leader's institute] with the appropriate public group or role at Read Only.

field_level_security.experience_cloud_profiles: All Commercialization__c fields must have FLS configured for Experience Cloud guest and authenticated profiles.
field_level_security.sensitive_field_rule: Evaluator_Notes__c must not be visible to the PI profile or Experience Cloud profiles.

integrations.name: Wellspring CSV Upsert
integrations.mechanism: CSV upsert via Data Loader or equivalent
integrations.blocker: Wellspring CSV schema pending from Research Strategy. Sample files not yet received.
pre_requisites: Mapping document approved by Research Strategy

deliverables: Create AAR_Record__c object with all fields
Create AAR_Submission__c object with master-detail to AAR_Record__c
Create AAR_Reviewer__c object with master-detail to AAR_Record__c and lookup to User
Create Commercialization__c SHELL only: Wellspring_ID__c, Contact__c, AAR_Record__c, Title__c
Extend Contact with Grants_System_ID__c, Institute__c, Is_Active_PI__c
Create permission sets: AAR_PI_Access, AAR_Evaluator_Access, AAR_Institute_Leadership
Configure sharing model (Private) on AAR_Record__c and Commercialization__c
Add deferred fields to Commercialization__c once CSV schema confirmed
Set FLS for all Commercialization__c fields on Experience Cloud profiles

phases.criteria_summary: All Phase 1 stories Done, UAT signed off, zero P1/P2 defects, 80% PI completion in pilot, Grants sync 100% match, security review approved

deployment_notes: Validate all objects and permission sets in sandbox before production deploy
Run Apex tests after any trigger deployment (especially AAR_Reviewer__c Apex Managed Sharing)
Confirm FLS on Experience Cloud profiles post-deploy
Manual push confirmation required before any remote repository update
